The '''2016/17 FIS Freestyle Ski World Cup''' was the thirty eighth [[FIS Freestyle Ski World Cup|World Cup]] season in [[freestyle skiing]] organised by [[International Ski Federation]]. The season started on 3 September 2016 and ended on 26 March 2017. This season included six disciplines: [[mogul skiing|moguls]], [[aerial skiing|aerials]], [[ski cross]], [[halfpipe]], [[slopestyle]] and [[big air]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.fis-ski.com/DB/freestyle-freeski/freeski/calendar-results.html?&sectorcode=FS&seasoncode=2017&categorycode=WC&disciplinecode=MO,DM,AE,SX,HP,AET,SS,AETQ,BA&seasonmonth=X-2017|title=World Cup 2017 calendar and results|publisher=[[International Ski Federation]]}}</ref>
